note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (Independence Party-Progressive Party coalition under Davíð Oddsson), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: a powerful fishing industry and employers' organisations, strong trade unions, organised farmers close to the Progressive Party, a small and influential press, and no armed forces of its own (defence through NATO membership).

interest_groups.note: No standing army; the Coast Guard is the only armed service.
Includes the fishing industry, central to the economy.
Farmers and coastal communities; the Progressive Party is in government.
